entries.objective: A canary secret or API-key-like string in scanned content is redacted or blocks egress before the external call
entries.expected_result: A canary secret or API-key-like string in scanned content is redacted or blocks egress before the external call
entries.preconditions: Sanitization does not remove all secrets, canaries, internal hostnames, tokens, or sensitive paths; Prompt includes file snippets, findings text, or log lines influenced by the scanned repository; Disclosure approval is not cryptographically bound to the exact payload; The Mistral API key has access to prompt contents and logs are retained or trainable by default; Output parsing can be influenced by injected text

candidate_control_mappings.proposed_control: Minimize external payloads to structured finding metadata and explicitly exclude raw source unless approved
Run secret scanning, canary detection, and sensitive-pattern redaction before any egress
Bind human approval to a hash or immutable preview of the exact evidence payload
Use a dedicated least-privilege API key, disable retention or training where contractually possible, and log requests
Treat model output as untrusted and sanitize before it becomes a patch, test, or PR comment
Prefer local Ollama for source-aware remediation and require explicit approval for external disclosure
Apply data-loss prevention and egress inspection for prompts containing source-like content

procedure.assertions: Assert both denied behavior and authorized behavior where applicable
procedure.evidence: Collect pytest output, fixture configuration, observed policy decisions and code revision
procedure.cleanup: Destroy ephemeral test state; preserve sanitized evidence
